findings.namedBuyers: Melanie Misener, CRA Executive Director, is the senior organizer relationship route. Lisa Aceti, Empire Travel Luxury Travel Advisor, is the named agent in CRA’s linked booking form and the strongest identified accommodation-process contact. Lisa Anderson, Membership & Event Coordinator on her professional profile, is a programme-coordination route. Mandy Consoli, CRA Executive Coordinator, is an additional internal routing contact. None is verified as hotel-contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming inaugural edition, January 10–17, 2027, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates, not publication dates: arrival and welcome lounge January 10, education January 12–15, closing dinner January 16, departure January 17. No later CRA Connect edition was identified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: a potentially suitable future guestroom-led resort conference, not a large exhibition. CRA offers leadership sessions, networking, companions and leisure, and explicitly rules out a big trade show or tabletop exhibits. Wyndham Alltra has 620 rooms, three meeting facilities totaling 380 square metres, capacity up to 300 conference/200 banquet, and outdoor event areas on Uvero Alto Beach. Fit remains conditional on actual peak rooms, plenary layout, concurrent sessions, family needs and air-package pricing; no event demand volume is published in the reviewed sources.
findings.venueCommitments: Dreams Onyx Resort & Spa, Punta Cana, is explicitly announced as host, with event-specific travel/accommodation deposits. This establishes an announced venue commitment, not merely generic resort promotion. The signed hotel contract, block size and exclusivity terms are not public in the reviewed material.
findings.historicalRotation: No prior CRA Connect Caribbean edition or destination-rotation timeline is established. CRA calls 2027 its first Caribbean conference and an inaugural proof-of-concept. Other CRA trade shows and regional meetings are not predecessor editions of this programme. Annual recurrence and a 2028 edition are unverified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: CRA directs attendees through its designated travel process and dedicated agent; the linked form names Lisa Aceti, Empire Travel. CRA says finalized group pricing would be obtained from Air Canada Vacations. Published milestones: initial commitment April 30, 2026; second deposit September 1; final payment November 1, 2026. All precede the November 14 research date. Hotel selection is committed elsewhere; late attendee availability and actual payment completion remain unknown. No public hotel RFP or alternative-hotel sourcing invitation was found.
findings.organizationStructure: Canadian Rental Association is the event-owning trade association for Canadian event and equipment rental businesses, not a PCO or hotel. Empire Travel is the attendee travel-advisor route; Air Canada Vacations is the named prospective group-pricing supplier. Dreams Onyx is the announced host resort. No separate PCO or destination DMC is identified in the reviewed event material. The conference is expressly not a CRA Board meeting.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The principal barrier is the event-specific Dreams Onyx host selection and integrated travel booking route, not geographic mismatch. No sourced overflow allocation, sellout, incumbent capacity problem, rate disadvantage or displacement opportunity was found. “Space is limited” describes an intentionally limited inaugural experience; it does not establish overflow demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Melanie Misener and Lisa Aceti with a brief future-host introduction, explicitly acknowledging Dreams Onyx for 2027. Ask whether CRA intends to repeat the format, who owns hotel selection, and when review begins; request actual room pickup, peak rooms, meeting layouts and travel-package requirements after the inaugural event. Include Lisa Anderson for programme requirements. Propose a post-event debrief after January 17, 2027, and only prepare a hotel proposal if invited. Do not pitch unverified 2027 overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of November 14, 2026, do not treat 2027 guestrooms as available to Wyndham Alltra: the host is Dreams Onyx and the published final-payment deadline has passed. Late registration/booking status is unknown. Public attendance is restricted to CRA members and partners; partnership or sponsorship participation would require CRA approval and is not hotel sourcing.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop a conditional relationship for a later resort edition only if CRA elects to repeat this proof-of-concept and competitively reviews hotels. No recurrence commitment, next-edition dates, rotation policy or future bid window was found. Do not assign January 2028 dates or forecast rooms/revenue.
